dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible presence of multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral plane. The most prominent structures exhibit a sharp, high-contrast outer perimeter of light-colored pixels transitioning to a dark charcoal interior, with edge geometry varying from perfect circles to elongated ovals.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, solid light-colored pixel clusters located primarily along the ventral-lateral margin. These clusters exhibit high core pixel concentration and lack the internal dark gradients characteristic of the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-midline 'O' rings form an obtuse scalene triangle. The spatial relationship is defined by a narrow angle between the two anterior-most centroids relative to the more distant posterior centroid.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity yellow specular reflection from the ocular region at the anterior-most point of the frame.
